This is a personal theory crafted after reading The Dark Tower series. I believe that Roland is both the Red King and Roland. As Roland begins his ascent up the tower he is plagued by good and bad memories. I think somewhere along the way he loses the fight against his mind and goes mad inside of the Tower. The reason why he is stuck on the balcony is because of the "errors" he made in the version/reality of the tower and the tower's influences. One thing he remembers constantly throughout almost every book is The Horn of Eld. That is one of the "errors" that need to be completed throughout the tower's cycles for him to get past a certain level inside of the tower. I could be wrong. Apparently at the end of the books he has the horn of eld and begins a new loop.
